summary.plain: A huge new water tank being built underground near Kamioka: 68 metres across and 71 metres tall, more than five times the volume of Super-Kamiokande, ringed with tens of thousands of new light sensors.
summary.technical: Water Cherenkov detector under construction, 68 m diameter x 71 m height, 260 kt total / 188 kt fiducial mass. Inner detector design centres on new large-aperture PMTs (order 20,000-40,000 depending on which official figure is used) plus ~1,000 multi-PMT 'compound eye' modules; outer veto up to 10,000 smaller PMTs. Housed in a purpose-excavated 69 m x 94 m cavern in the Tochibora mine, about 8 km from Super-Kamiokande.

technology.quote: a huge cylindrical water tank, 68 meters in diameter and 71 meters deep
technology.value: Large cylindrical water Cherenkov tank, the successor design to Super-Kamiokande, instrumented with new high-sensitivity large-aperture PMTs and multi-PMT 'compound-eye' photosensor modules.
